subject: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest — Novus Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novushealth.com>, Tom Ryder <tom.ryder@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest — Novus Health

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement path and timeline: 

Summary of what we heard
- Procurement preference: likely AWS Marketplace (Tom mentioned wanting the Marketplace path first).
- Finance requires a PO for committing to production workloads (card not preferred for larger contracts).
- Typical internal approval cycle looks to be ~3–6 weeks (procurement + legal).
- Must-have docs: SOC 2 Type II report, data handling summary, standard MSA (one-way redline ok).

Action items / next steps
1) I will send a short vendor packet and confirm Redwood’s AWS Marketplace SKU process (deliverable: pricing SKU + estimated monthly invoice cadence). — Neha (by EOD today)
2) Can you loop in procurement@novushealth.com with any vendor intake form we need to complete? Tom, if you can share the procurement contact name that speeds things up.
3) Marissa, can you advise on any marketplace pricing levers (standard marketplace listing vs private listing discount)?
4) Dev, please confirm technical artifacts/manifest Novus needs for marketplace listing (AMI, permissions, support window).

Attached: placeholder "Novus_vendor_form.pdf" (fillable vendor intake) — please confirm if this captures the fields your procurement team needs.

If the Marketplace route is the priority we’ll prepare both a PO-friendly order form and a DocuSign route so finance has options.

Thanks — happy to set a quick follow-up with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novushealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ryder <tom.ryder@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest — Novus Health

Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 
- Procurement prefers AWS Marketplace if the commercial terms match our internal cadence. Marketplace is our first preference because it simplifies billing and approvals.
- For commitments >$25k/year we require a PO (we do not put corporate cards on file for multiyear commitments).
- Procurement contact is procurement@novushealth.com (shared here). My colleague Tom will shepherd the intake.

We’ve attached our vendor intake template for reference (filled fields will depend on your vendor portal). We’ll need your SOC 2 Type II and standard MSA; legal will do a quick redline. Timeline estimate: once we have the vendor packet + SOC 2, procurement predicts ~3–5 weeks for a standard Marketplace flow with PO and internal approvals.

Tom — can you confirm if you want us to pursue a public Marketplace listing or a private listing first? For now, we’d prefer public Marketplace if possible.

Appreciate the follow-up.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Sr. Director, Product Operations | Novus Health
Sarah.Liu@novushealth.com

Attachments: Novus_vendor_form.pdf (completed)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novushealth.com>, Tom Ryder <tom.ryder@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest — Novus Health

Looping in a couple quick items on pricing and ops: 
- We can support a standard AWS Marketplace public listing which covers your preference (Sarah). That path typically requires a Marketplace SKU and a one-time onboarding with AWS (we handle most of it).
- Pricing options: public SKU at list price OR a private listing / promotional SKU if Novus needs a negotiated rate. For deals with PO commitments we typically structure a 10% pre-committed discount for first-year annualized spend (this is flexible).
- Next from Sales ops: Neha, please request the minimum billing cadence Novus wants (monthly vs annual invoicing). Dev, can you confirm the artifact checklist for AWS (AMI, support contact, manifest, and minimal health-checks)?

I’ll prepare a short pricing sheet and a marketplace onboarding checklist today and share as a follow-up. If Novus prefers, we’ll prepare both: (1) Marketplace listing path with PO-friendly order form and (2) direct purchase order contract. That way procurement can choose the easier path.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novushealth.com>, Tom Ryder <tom.ryder@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest — Novus Health

On Fri, Mar 19, 2027 at 09:12 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement path and timeline: 

Thanks — quick tech checklist for Marketplace listing and PO flow: 
- Marketplace artifacts we provide: AMI/image or container image, minimal manifest (name, version, required IAM permissions), support contact + SLA text, and a short integration guide (2–3 pages).
- For private listing vs public listing: public listing needs the marketplace onboarding (AWS review) which may add 5–7 business days; private listings are faster but require AWS partner setup.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II, encryption-at-rest summary, and data retention notes. I’ve attached a short CSV checklist: "redwood_marketplace_checklist.csv" and sample manifest "ami_manifest_sample.json" for Novus procurement to review.

If Novus wants the public Marketplace route and PO-based invoices we’ll create: (A) Marketplace SKU + pricing sheet, (B) Order form that maps to PO fields, (C) MSA + suggested redlines.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement to walk through the checklist if that helps.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_checklist.csv, ami_manifest_sample.json
